# Shabpa (شب‌پا)

> Free, open-source (MIT) Windows 10/11 utility in Persian and English: scheduled shutdown and sleep with a cancellable countdown, a game overlay (FPS, temperatures, ping) that injects nothing into games, per-app internet speed limits, game tuning with full undo, an offline command box (Bidar), tasks and focus, verified backups, system health, night light and a Telegram remote. No telemetry, no accounts.

- [Home (Persian)](https://shabpa.ir/)
- [Home (English)](https://shabpa.ir/en/)
- [Source code and releases](https://github.com/MrPitPot/shabpa)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/MrPitPot/shabpa/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Security policy](https://github.com/MrPitPot/shabpa/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
